prompt: Houses inside giant mushrooms on a mushroom island.

card.name: Mushroom Island Hamlet

site.text: A mushroom island, with homes set inside giant mushrooms rising from the mycelium

style.text: Giant mushrooms: red and brown caps, white stems, glowing and whimsical, hollowed out into homes

purpose.text: A cozy residential community of homes inside giant mushrooms

card.interpretation: You want a small residential settlement on a mushroom island where the houses are hollowed-out giant mushrooms. I read the site as an existing mushroom island (found, not sculpted), the style as a whimsical giant-mushroom look, and the purpose as a home base, with mushroom houses around a larger communal hall.
assumptions: Size M, medium density, about 10 buildings within the 64-block claim.
Purpose taken as a home base since only houses were mentioned.
An existing mushroom island is used if one is near; otherwise terrain would need sculpting.
Added a hall, garden, boathouse and lookout to support the homes.

program.notes: Hollowed giant mushroom stem and cap; round rooms, door in stem, windows in cap, glowstone lighting.
Largest mushroom, a communal hall with a wide cap and spiral stairs inside the stem.
Small mushroom-farm cottage tending crops of mushrooms.
Small mushroom-capped shed for boats at the shore.
Tall thin mushroom stem with a lookout in the cap.
